SELECT CUSTOMERID, CUSTOMERNAME, CUSTOMERTYPE, GENDER FROM DW.DIMCUSTOMER WHERE CUSTOMERTYPE = 'RETAIL'

SELECT CUSTOMERID, CUSTOMERNAME, CUSTOMERTYPE, GENDER FROM DW.DIMCUSTOMER WHERE CUSTOMERTYPE = 'CORPORATE'

SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMERTYPE FROM DW.DIMCUSTOMER

SELECT * FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer

CREATE TABLE [DW].[DimCustomerNameTest_20240118]
( 
	[Customerid] [varchar](20)  NOT NULL,
	[Customername] [nvarchar](1025)  NOT NULL,
	[Gender] [varchar](6)  NULL,
	[Customertype] [varchar](20)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
GO


--FIRSTNAME FEMALE
SELECT DISTINCT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.CUSTOMERID) RN, FirstName,GenderId, 'RETAIL' CUSTOMERTYPE INTO DW.TEMP_FNAME FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer A
JOIN  DW.DIMCUSTOMER B ON A.CustomerId = B.CUSTOMERID
WHERE GenderId = 'F'

SELECT * FROM DW.TEMP_FNAME

--LASTNAME FEMALE
SELECT DISTINCT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.CUSTOMERID DESC) RN, Lastname,GenderId, 'RETAIL' CUSTOMERTYPE INTO DW.TEMP_LNAME FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer A
JOIN  DW.DIMCUSTOMER B ON A.CustomerId = B.CUSTOMERID
WHERE GenderId = 'F' AND LASTNAME NOT IN ('SY','DEE')

SELECT * FROM DW.TEMP_LNAME

--CUSTOMERID FEMALE
SELECT DISTINCT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY INDIVIDUALCUSTOMERNAME) RN, A.CUSTOMERID,GenderId, 'RETAIL' CUSTOMERTYPE INTO DW.TEMP_CUSTID FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer A
JOIN  DW.DIMCUSTOMER B ON A.CustomerId = B.CUSTOMERID
WHERE GenderId = 'F'

SELECT * FROM DW.TEMP_CUSTID

--RANDOM FEMALE
INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerNameTest_20240118
SELECT CID.CUSTOMERID CustomerID
,CONCAT(FNAME.FIRSTNAME, ' ', LNAME.LASTNAME) CustomerName
,CASE WHEN CID.GENDERID = 'M' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Female' END Gender, FNAME.CUSTOMERTYPE
FROM DW.TEMP_FNAME FNAME
JOIN DW.TEMP_LNAME LNAME ON FNAME.RN = LNAME.RN
JOIN DW.TEMP_CUSTID CID ON FNAME.RN = CID.RN 

select * from DW.DimCustomerNameTest

drop table DW.TEMP_FNAME
drop table DW.TEMP_LNAME
drop table DW.TEMP_CUSTID

WHERE GenderId = 'M' AND LASTNAME NOT IN ('SY','DEE');

SELECT DISTINCT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY INDIVIDUALCUSTOMERNAME) RN, A.CUSTOMERID,GenderId, 'RETAIL' CUSTOMERTYPE INTO DW.TEMP_CUSTID FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer A
JOIN  DW.DIMCUSTOMER B ON A.CustomerId = B.CUSTOMERID
WHERE GenderId = 'M';

SELECT * FROM DW.TEMP_CUSTID

--RANDOM MALE
INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerNameTest_20240118
SELECT CID.CUSTOMERID CustomerID
,CONCAT(FNAME.FIRSTNAME, ' ', LNAME.LASTNAME) CustomerName
,CASE WHEN CID.GENDERID = 'M' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Female' END Gender, FNAME.CUSTOMERTYPE
FROM DW.TEMP_FNAME FNAME

INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerNameTest_20240118
SELECT CID.CUSTOMERID CustomerID
,LNAME.Lastname CustomerName
,NULL Gender, CNAME.CUSTOMERTYPE
FROM DW.TEMP_CNAME CNAME
JOIN DW.TEMP_CCUSTID CID ON CNAME.RN = CID.RN

select customerid, count(1) from DW.DimCustomerNameTest group by customerid having count(1)>1
select * from DW.DimCustomerNameTest where customerid = 'R01789677'

select row_number() over(partition by customerid order by customername) rn,* into DW.DimCustomerNameTest1 from DW.DimCustomerNameTest 

select Customerid,Customername, Gender,Customertype into DW.DimCustomerNameTest  from DW.DimCustomerNameTest1 where rn = 1
